'''Infobox town''' replaces the "Characteristics" section of most town pages. Feel free to further develop it. Please note that the fields below all pertain to the ''[[World of Warcraft]]'' [[MMORPG]], although some may come from official sources of lore and should be cited. ; Valid field entries: *'''faction:''' Alliance, Horde, or Neutral based on the MMORPG only (default Neutral) *'''name:''' town name (default PAGENAME). *'''ss:''' ideal picture of the town [optional] *'''caption:''' screenshot caption [optional] *'''type:''' the type of town. Examples: City, Village, Camp *'''pop:''' total population of the town *'''lpop:''' last known population of the town *'''race:''' races within the town. Population breakdown for each race in parenthesis [optional]. Please use the following separated by line breaks (
): : {{t|Race|Blood elf}} = {{Race|Blood elf}} : {{t|Race|Dark Iron}} = {{Race|Dark Iron}} : {{t|Race|Draenei}} = {{Race|Draenei}} : {{t|Race|Dwarf}} = {{Race|Dwarf}} : {{t|Race|Goblin}} = {{Race|Goblin}} : {{t|Race|Gnome}} = {{Race|Gnome}} : {{t|Race|Human}} = {{Race|Human}} : {{t|Race|Night elf}} = {{Race|Night elf}} : {{t|Race|Orc}} = {{Race|Orc}} : {{t|Race|Tauren}} = {{Race|Tauren}} : {{t|Race|Troll}} = {{Race|Troll}} : {{t|Race|Forsaken}} = {{Race|Forsaken}} : or Other when needed - see [[:Template:Race]] *'''frace:''' races that used to be in the town [only use if race parameter is used] *'''government''': list type of government [optional] *'''leader:''' list only if there is a recognized leader of that specific town [optional] *'''fleader:''' a list of former leaders of that specific town [only use if leader parameter is used] *'''language:''' languages within the town [optional] *'''faith:''' faiths within the town [optional] *'''resource:''' resources within the town [optional] *'''affiliation:''' the affiliation of the zone, usually the faction that controls it [optional] *'''faffiliation:''' the former affiliations of the town [only use if affiliation parameter is used] *'''organizations:''' the organizations that hold this town as their base of operations [optional] *'''loc:''' location of zone, or if not known then the general area of zone in relation to the rest of the continent *'''status:''' what is the current status of the town. Examples: Active, abandoned, evacuating, destroyed [optional] *'''facilities:''' used to show the normal facilities [optional] **'''inn:''' has an inn, yes/no **'''mailbox:''' has a mailbox, yes/no **'''stables:''' has a stable master, yes/no **'''anvil:''' has an anvil and forge, yes/no **'''bank:''' has a bank, yes/no **'''auctions:''' has an auction house, yes/no *'''trainers:''' used to show the if town contains trainers [optional] **'''class:''' has a class trainer, yes/no **'''profession:''' has a profession trainer, yes/no *'''travel:''' used to show the traveling options [optional] **'''flightpath:''' has a flight master, yes/no **'''boat:''' has a boat, zeppelin or other mass-transit options, yes/no **'''portal:''' has a permanent portal that leads out, yes/no *'''source:''' where the info came from!
